hook_anchors.why: Juliana's sudden terrified scream establishes immediate mortal danger from the fire.

hook_anchors.excerpt: A violent crash as the bedroom door is kicked open.
hook_anchors.why: A sudden explosive jolt breaks the mounting tension as someone forces entry into the burning room.

hook_anchors.excerpt: Wide shot of the room as a massive burning crossbeam collapses into the floorboards
hook_anchors.why: A high-impact visual of structural failure immediately escalates the physical peril.

hook_anchors.excerpt: Alexander leaps forward, using his shoulder and back to shatter through the burning window
hook_anchors.why: A thrilling stunt action beat as they crash through glass to escape the inferno.

hook_anchors.excerpt: They took our home. I will not let them take anything else now.
hook_anchors.why: A cold, lethal declaration of intent and promise of vengeance.

cliffhanger_anchors.open_question: Will Juliana survive running back into the burning room for the ledger?
cliffhanger_anchors.why: Juliana defies Alexander and rushes back into deadly flames, creating immediate suspense.

cliffhanger_anchors.open_question: Who is responsible for deliberately burning down their cottage?
cliffhanger_anchors.why: The realization that the fire was an intentional attack sets up the central mystery and conflict.

cliffhanger_anchors.open_question: What is Alexander planning to do to the people responsible?
cliffhanger_anchors.excerpt: What are you going to do?
cliffhanger_anchors.why: Leaves the audience hanging right before Alexander acts on his vow of vengeance.
